hints.title: Serial Pattern Structure
hints.text: Filter the description column using a regular expression that checks for prefix SN followed by 4 digits, a hyphen, and another 4 digits.

hints.title: Boundary and Suffix Validation
hints.text: Ensure that the serial number is not directly followed by additional digits, which would indicate an invalid sequence.

hints.title: Ordering Result Set
hints.text: Order the matched products in ascending order by product_id.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT product_id, product_name, description
FROM products
WHERE description REGEXP '(^| )SN[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}($|[^0-9])'
ORDER BY product_id ASC;
```

variables: n: number of rows in products table
L: maximum string length of description
complexity.notes: Matches regular expression pattern against product description and sorts matching rows.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full table scan is necessary because description text cannot be indexed directly for substring regex patterns.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Regex matching filters rows directly in the storage engine before ordering.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Write regex respecting the SN prefix and strict 4-digit groups separated by hyphen.

solutions.code:
SELECT product_id, product_name, description
FROM products
WHERE description REGEXP '(^| )SN[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}($|[^0-9])'
ORDER BY product_id ASC;

SELECT product_id, product_name, description
FROM products
WHERE description ~ '(^|\s)SN[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}($|[^0-9])'
ORDER BY product_id ASC;
